name: Gamma
tagline: AI presentation and document builder for decks, docs, and sites

pricing.notes: Official pricing page checked; public 2026 coverage lists Plus at $12/month, while official crawler exposed annual-effective $9/seat/month.

verdictSummary: An AI slide generator is buildable, but Gamma's strength is layouts, editing model, exports, hosting, analytics, and shareable deck/site UX.
coreLoopDIY: Prompt an LLM for outline, generate slide/cards JSON, render with templates, export PDF/PPTX, and host a share page.
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay because the output looks acceptable without wrestling with PowerPoint.

notes: A strong modern yes/kinda: a viral category with open-source and API primitives.
prompt:
Build me a personal replacement for Gamma (AI presentation and document builder for decks, docs, and sites). Requirements:

- Core loop: Prompt an LLM for outline, generate slide/cards JSON, render with templates, export PDF/PPTX, and host a share page.
- Needs: LLM API.
- Needs: slide renderer.
- Needs: template system.
- Needs: export pipeline.
- Needs: hosted app.
- Needs: optional image API.
- Keep it personal-scale: no accounts, no telemetry, secrets in .env, SQLite or
  flat files for storage. Local-first wherever possible.
- Clean minimal UI where one is needed; CLI is fine where one is not.
- Include a README with setup steps, required keys, and any OS permissions.

Honest scope: this covers the core loop only. You will not get: polished editor; responsive card model; exports.
